item.title: Martha Jeske
item.description: Martha Jeske, 92, of Jamestown, passed away January 14. A Mass of Christian Burial will be held on Thursday, January 22 at 10:00 AM at St. James Basilica in Jamestown. Interment will be at Highland Home Cemetery.
